plan.name: Services are acyclic
plan.rationale: A cycle ties two services together. Neither can be released or rolled back on its own, and an outage in one spreads to the other.
plan.remediation: Break the cycle. For example, let fulfillment publish a shipped event that billing consumes, instead of calling billing.
